verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents natural-language AI commands layered on Playwright that act, extract, and validate, with a fallback to selectors (skyvern-docs-19). The SDK injects AI into every page interaction (skyvern-docs-5), and the project claims it maps visual elements to actions on sites it has never seen, replacing brittle Selenium-style scripts (skyvern-gh-1, skyvern-docs-13, skyvern-gh-2). One hands-on report says it struggled to click a tab and a popup on an unfamiliar site (skyvern-comm-2), which suggests uneven reliability but does not directly contradict the resilience claim. Missing for 10: detailed docs for the individual click/type primitives on described elements, concrete evidence of surviving selector or layout changes, and independent corroboration of robustness.
